## Required

ROS 4.2.0 has 33 fields, 19 mandatory: trip/set identities, setting times, positions, speeds and hook counts.

Required gear details cover floatline and branchline lengths, leader material/share, shark lines and target species.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

Every set has endpoint times, positions and hook/basket counts. Vessel speed exists for 458 sets.

Shooter speed exists for 20 sets; one additional recorded shooter use lacks a speed.

All sets have floatline compositions; 333 exceed three distinct lengths. Eighteen contain a zero length.

Recorded trip targets do not establish set targets.

## To decide

Confirm times, speed units, unused-shooter treatment, gear meanings and selection of up to three floatline lengths.

Establish shark-line use and set targets. Preserve one row per set and its links to dependent sheets.

An empty sheet requires all descendant sheets to be empty. Reporting requirements remain open.
